title: Decode an allergy bitmask
summary: Decode a bitmask into an ordered list of allergens.
requirements: Bits 0..7 correspond to eggs, peanuts, shellfish, strawberries, tomatoes, chocolate, pollen, cats.
Return allergens in the order specified here.
hints: Each allergen corresponds to a power of two.
Use bitwise AND to test whether each bit is set.
